Honesty can coexist with care; in fact, care is what makes honesty bearable.

There are edge cases, of course — if someone is in a crisis and can’t process a hard truth right now, I’d hold space for their feelings first and circle back to the honest conversation later. But that’s timing, not prioritizing comfort over honesty. The truth still matters; you just meet someone where they are first.

At the end of the day, I think both people in a relationship deserve to be seen as they are. If I can’t be honest with you, you’re not really in a relationship with me — you’re in a relationship with a version of me I’ve curated to please you. And that’s not fair to either of us."}
